:::{#thm-bernoulli-score-equation}
#### Solution of the score equation of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$ and the observed sample mean satisfies $0 < \outbar < 1$,
then the score equation $\score(\prob) = 0$ has exactly one solution in $(0, 1)$:
the sample mean $\prob = \outbar$.

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-score-equation, worked in @sol-bernoulli-score-equation.

:::
